content: @CStamp Indeed. But then I have a phobia about tall buildings and especially highway bridges. I lived through the '71 San Fernando earthquake where all of the highway overpasses north of the Valley collapsed. Especially stuck in my mind was a photo of a Chevy pickup truck that got smashed killing the poor guy on his way to work. After seeing that as a kid, I don't trust bridges. And then the whole thing was compounded by the guy who lost his wife in the Nimitz freeway collapse.
